forward_map.preparation: real psi+; fixed common Rx(pi/2) frame gives phi+ up to global phase
forward_map.pulses: A: Rx(pi/2) then optional Ry(pi/2); B: R_(x+theta)(pi/2) then optional R_(y+theta)(pi/2)
forward_map.family_map: Bob color-X conjugation reverses z; feed transformed Bob axes and herald=+1 to the unchanged psi+ family.

claim_scope.hypothesis: Original source Bell law with the explicitly fixed ideal Methods nominal phase alignment, ideal real-Bell preparation and ideal outcome assignment.
claim_scope.event_policy: First 100000 main-file trials in original row order; all settings and outcomes retained; stop earlier only at file end.
claim_scope.source_to_apparatus: A conditional nominal apparatus model, not an empirical proof of its calibration.
claim_scope.phase_identity: theta_geo denotes the Methods relative basis angle. No fitted offset or theta_control is used, and Supplement Eq16 is not asserted equal to this geometric angle.
claim_scope.calibration: No disjoint visibility/F0/F1 or simultaneous phase-error record; optional calibrated model omitted and its alpha unused.
claim_scope.uncertainty: Frozen conditional per-cell radius sensitivity. No radius is estimated or selected from test events.
claim_scope.verdict_meaning: A rejection applies to this joint source-plus-ideal-apparatus claim. It does not identify the source alone as the cause. Non-rejection is not verification of the whole theory.
